summary: Verified iter-8 hotfix (cookie auth + admin push VAPID) end-to-end on preview URL. 13/13 backend tests pass (login sets HttpOnly+Secure cookies, /auth/me works via cookies, /chat/unread returns {count} for authed and 401 unauthed, /auth/refresh works with only refresh cookie and issues new access cookie, /auth/logout clears cookies, /admin/push/config returns {configured:true, public_key:...} without leaking private key, non-admin gets 403, unauth gets 401, push subscription accepts fcm.googleapis.com endpoint and rejects evil.example.com with 422, register/status/delete round trip works, /admin/push/test on unknown endpoint returns 404 not 503). Frontend admin panel loads, admin-push section rendered, push-not-configured message is NOT shown (VAPID configured), /sw.js served with content-type application/javascript. Push-enable button appears disabled in headless because Notification.permission is 'denied' (expected; cannot be granted headlessly per review note). Session persistence verified via cookies.
critical_code_review_comments: cookie_options() defaults SameSite=none in preview (COOKIE_DOMAIN unset) which is correct for cross-origin preview URLs; production must set COOKIE_DOMAIN=.magicgame.store to switch to Lax as designed.

services/push.py accepts VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY (raw base64url) or VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM; default endpoint hosts list covers FCM/Mozilla/Windows/Apple. Endpoint validation correctly rejects non-allowed hosts and requires https + port None/443 + no query/fragment.
/admin/push/config correctly gates public_key behind configured() and require_admin; private key is never exposed.
logout only clears cookies; consider also rotating/revoking refresh token server-side (currently a stolen refresh cookie remains valid until natural expiry). Non-blocking for hotfix scope.
seed_data_creation: None (temporary QA user registered via /auth/register for 403 test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hotfix scope: cookie-based auth (SameSite=none in preview, Lax+Domain in prod) and admin push VAPID env acceptance. In headless Chromium Notification.permission is 'denied' so the push-enable button is disabled by design (state='refusées'); to positively confirm the enable button, use a real browser or grant notifications via CDP Browser.grantPermissions at the context level BEFORE page load — grant_permissions after navigation still returned denied. /sw.js is at frontend/public/sw.js and served as application/javascript.
rca of the issue: Bug 1 (401 on /auth/me in production): cookies were set with SameSite=None but no Domain, so magicgame.store and api.magicgame.store were treated as cross-site and cookies dropped. Fix adds cookie_options() reading COOKIE_DOMAIN env; when set, cookie is scoped to .magicgame.store (first-party, SameSite=Lax). Verified cookies attach correctly across API paths. Bug 2 ('VAPID requise'): push.py only read VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM/PUSH_ENDPOINT_HOSTS but Render provided VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY. Fix reads either env var and hard-codes a sensible default endpoint host allowlist. /admin/push/config confirmed configured=true.
